pattern_note: Clustered water bodies share few tiles. Dispersed water bodies touch many tiles. Report distinct tiles and tile-dates with every run.
size_note: Smallest water body is 10 m across, assumption A7. Report interior and shoreline pixel counts per resolution.
live_provider_policy: Run counts progressively. One request stream at first. Fixture runs are not a provider capacity benchmark. Record bucket, region, payer, bytes, and requests.
targets_note: No target is set. Assumption A14: no budget exists. Targets follow measurements.
history_order: 2021-01-01 first, per decision 0003. 2017-01-01 deferred to a later legacy-tier decision.
